title: GPT-2 XL's token wall: supply, need, and what it actually processed

series.label: re-read copies of the same tokens

caption: WebText holds ~10B unique tokens (~6.7 per parameter); the Chinchilla-fitted ~20 tokens/param asks 30B for 1.5B parameters -- 3x the supply. The original run covered the gap by re-reading: ~167B processed tokens, of which ~157B were repeats of the same unique pool. Book values, rounded.

title: Marginal ICR halves with each corpus doubling (illustrative model)
xLabel: dataset size relative to first corpus
caption: The chapter's illustrative model: marginal ICR ~ 1/(O_sample x D). Each doubling of consumed data halves what the next FLOP learns -- the frontier bends down, which is why pruning repeats beats buying more corpus at the margin.

title: Dedup savings accumulating against a fixed setup cost
caption: The book's worked dedup pipeline: gross saving is \$6k per run against a fixed \$30k setup. The bar reaches the cost at five runs; net ROI is therefore negative at one run, break-even at five, and positive after that (+100% at ten runs in the worked accounting).
